sentences.text:
This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.559/2023, registered at Police Station Ashta, District Sehore (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 450, 506 of IPC.
2.
Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that daughter of applicant is said to have been abducted by brother of prosecutrix, therefore, false report has been lodged against him.
It is submitted that applicant is innocent.
In these circumstances, applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for State opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.

It is submitted by him that prosecutrix, in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, has Ramnarayan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49698498/
1 unequivocally stated that applicant has committed rape on her.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is some delay in lodging of FIR.
Delay occurred as husband of prosecutrix was killed by somebody.
Before his death, he was called by relative of Ram Narayan for a meeting.
In these circumstances, application for anticipatory bail may be dismissed.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties 5.
Considering the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
